independentInventory.error: Preparation catches exceptions into failed state.
independentInventory.bypass: Complete packet accounting cannot establish relevance or entailment.

independentInventory.evidence: Captured group, packet-local n1 handles, numbered original source tokens, actual hidden cloze indices
independentInventory.predicate: Exact schema; contiguous full inventory; unique target per target range; valid explicit role; exact handle; existing cloze index; required scoped records.
independentInventory.effect: Retains independently valid records while unresolved errors keep group incomplete.
independentInventory.error: Invalid top-level JSON/schema throws; invalid nested records become unresolved with path/context.
independentInventory.bypass: Accepted model statuses remain unverified semantic judgments. Missing leaf evidence cannot bypass decoder.

independentInventory.guard: Required field evidence and finding dependencies
independentInventory.evidence: Captured text, exact field spans, note scope, status and related findings
independentInventory.predicate: Nonempty supported/changed/source-conflict evidence; supported records contain known spans; unsupported/changed verdicts require corresponding finding; empty Extra requires empty status and evidence.
independentInventory.effect: Rejects invalid receipt instead of manufacturing approval or falsehood.
independentInventory.error: Throws validation error that V4 quarantines for that record.
independentInventory.bypass: The schema lacks field-level inconclusive status; propose this separately as policy/design. Known citation IDs and substrings do not imply semantic relevance.

independentInventory.evidence: Prior and next independently parsed V4 records and same group JSON signature
independentInventory.predicate: Same packetSignature/protocol; merge by factId/noteId; require every selected fact/scoped note plus no unresolved error.
independentInventory.effect: Retains accepted records, replaces valid same-ID records, unions findings/recovery provenance; prevents record duplication.
independentInventory.error: Different captured packet throws. Public loop keeps failure evidence.
independentInventory.bypass: Combining complementary attempts can preserve different model judgments; this is provenance/semantic uncertainty, not demonstrated false protocol completion.

independentInventory.evidence: Captured original prompts/model/settings, accepted group statuses, attempt history, live run reference
independentInventory.predicate: Only groups without complete results run; exact captured request must exist; stale currentness checked before/after await; truncated responses skipped; transport failure stops session.
independentInventory.effect: Retries incomplete groups, retains completed work and attempts, quarantines invalid/truncated groups.
independentInventory.error: Transport publishes failed/cancelled; validation errors allow other groups; stale state publishes interrupted.
independentInventory.bypass: Receipt helper suite does not execute React event scheduling; independent lifecycle suite is needed for runtime dispatch claims.

independentInventory.evidence: Captured cards and batch references, selected tier, current batch/KB identity
independentInventory.effect: Interrupts stale work and excludes its receipt claims from current queue; marks downloads outdated.
independentInventory.error: Stale evidence remains downloadable with checkComplete false.
independentInventory.bypass: Relies on immutable state updates. Actual updateField HTML:5861 and source-link handlers allocate new cards arrays. In-place mutation hypothetical is not a reproduced public path.

calls: HTML:5362 receipt queue; HTML:5366 local queue
independentInventory.evidence: Actual valid clozes, known reliable mappings, captured fact span, referenced hidden answers
independentInventory.predicate: Script comparison requires complete undisputed mapping; numeric recall comparison requires tested status, valid span and refs, then compares source number strings to hidden number strings.
independentInventory.effect: Warnings only; [] means no applicable warning. Separate source-link and numeric status report missing/disputed evidence.
independentInventory.error: Missing/invalid source or refs return []; receipt path already rejects them at decoding boundary.
independentInventory.bypass: A semantic error can escape these bounded heuristics. No code here upgrades [] to supported status.

independentInventory.effect: Creates advisory acknowledgement record; does not alter Text, Extra, Tags, Keep or export.
independentInventory.error: Invalid disposition, stale capture or missing/ineligible covered-by note throws.

independentInventory.evidence: Item signature, captured cards/batch/tier/preparedAt, current references, complete/pending groups, errors and hashes
independentInventory.predicate: Decision signatures and reference identity match; only newest decision current. Report complete requires current capture, complete status, all groups checked and no failure.
independentInventory.effect: Marks superseded/outdated decisions and incomplete reports; preserves explicit model judgment limitation.
independentInventory.error: Hash failure produces null/unavailable flag; save handler reports export failure.
independentInventory.bypass: Hashes establish bytes rather than clinical truth; completed means protocol accounting, as UI HTML:5469 and metadata explicitly state.

candidateVerdicts.candidate: Missing leaf evidence silently approves invalid receipt
candidateVerdicts.basis: Invalid note handles, missing indices, unknown source and absent required evidence produce incomplete V4 results. Leaf [] never supplies supported status.

candidateVerdicts.candidate: Checker suggestions or Fixed acknowledgement automatically repair from model knowledge
candidateVerdicts.basis: Real suggestion queue/decision functions preserve all cards/export bytes. No automatic application path in reviewed handler.

candidateVerdicts.candidate: Changed notes retain current audit decisions
candidateVerdicts.basis: Cards array identity changes; helper currentness and active audit effect invalidate captures. Receipt tests independently cover Text, source batch, selected tier and Keep changes.

candidateVerdicts.candidate: Complementary retry duplicates records or accepts different packet
candidateVerdicts.basis: Same-packet partial records merge once; repeated merge has one fact/one note; changed captured fact body throws.

candidateVerdicts.candidate: An exact source citation guarantees meaning
candidateVerdicts.verdict: semantic limitation, not deterministic coding defect
candidateVerdicts.basis: Six intentionally false mock judgments remain supported; DECISIONS.md, UI and report explicitly disclaim semantic certification. These are not observed Gemini errors or error-rate measurements.

candidateVerdicts.candidate: Receipt fixtures use wrong source pointer shape
candidateVerdicts.basis: make() calls real ankiSourceSnapshot. sources:[{filename,location}] and source footer assertions pass.

testQualityConcerns: Six failing assertions are deliberately stronger semantic expectations than the current deterministic decoder contract. Preserve their semantic-limit category; do not count them as six production defects or six actual checker model failures.
Receipt stage trace assembles real helpers in production order manually. It is not a run of the actual generation React handler; the separate lifecycle suite must support handler/event claims.

Preview/export assertions compare exported fields and the same extracted preview helper. They verify helper serialization invariance, not native Anki rendering or independently correct cloze semantics.
handle-guard-bypass mutation survives because downstream operations still quarantine the record. This discloses limited diagnostic-specific mutation coverage rather than public fail-open approval.
Complementary retry controls exercise merge helpers, not actual request scheduling; receipt script cannot alone establish stopped-session/late-response behavior.
Covered-elsewhere semantic relevance is a user judgment; the helper validates eligibility only. Manual fixed is acknowledgement, not evidence a correct text edit occurred.
Source currentness test replaces the batch object; it does not mutate a live KB in browser. Actual immutable UI handlers were inspected statically.
Existing shared fixture is used as a protocol-valid mock response builder, not expected semantic oracle. Expected source meaning is independently written in fixtures.
